Solve the following multiple-choice mathematics problem. You may reason before answering. End your final response with exactly "ANSWER: X", where X is one of A, B, C, D, E. Select one option.

today is thursday . i came home from a trip 3 days before the day after last monday . how many days have i been home ?

A. 1 day
B. 2 days
C. 7 days
D. 6 days
E. 10 days

message.content:
Saturday (3 days before the day after last Monday) → Thursday is 5 full days elapsed, but counting inclusively gives 6.

ANSWER: D
message.reasoning_content: Last Monday, day after is Tuesday, 3 days before Tuesday = Saturday. Thursday - Saturday = 5 days? Not an option. Hmm, maybe "last Monday" relative... If today Thursday, previous Monday was 3 days ago. Day after last Monday = Tuesday, 3 days before = Saturday. Home since Saturday: been home 5 days... not option. Perhaps count differently: 3 days before Tuesday = Saturday, arrived home, days home = 6? Saturday→Thursday is 5 days elapsed; including today 6? Answer D 6?
